insurer: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited

room_rent.note: Room rent limits are specified in the Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table, not in the wording itself. A Room Upgrade optional cover is available. Proportionate deduction applies if higher room is taken.

icu.note: ICU charges covered; proportionate deductions explicitly not applicable for ICU. Specific limit per Policy Schedule/Benefit Table.

copayment.display: Age 61+ at entry: co-pay as per Benefit Table
copayment.note: Co-payment applies per claim if age at entry of insured (or eldest in floater) is 61 years or above at inception of first policy. Percentage as per Product Benefit Table/Policy Schedule. Additional 15% co-pay if PPN Discount option chosen and treatment taken outside Preferred Provider Network.

sub_limits.display: Sub-limits for listed illnesses per Benefit Table
sub_limits.note: Section C.I.(j) specifies sub-limits for listed illnesses/conditions as per Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table. Specific amounts not stated in wording.

deductible.note: No aggregate deductible mentioned in the policy wording.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt.

ped_waiting.note: Pre-existing diseases covered after 24 months of continuous coverage from inception.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions (cataract, hernia, joint replacement etc.) have 24-month waiting period; joint replacement has 36-month waiting under Standard Plan.

maternity.note: Maternity expenses are a standard exclusion (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered. No optional maternity add-on mentioned.

cumulative_bonus.note: No Claim Bonus accrues each claim-free year; maximum cap is 50% of Sum Insured. On a claim, NCB reduces by 10% of SI. Alternatively, insured can opt for No Claim Discount on premium instead of NCB.

restoration.display: Once/year, up to SI (unrelated illness only)
restoration.note: Reload of Sum Insured available once per Policy Year for subsequent claims only; not available for same illness/injury for which a prior claim was admitted in that year. Applies to in-patient and day care claims. An 'Unlimited Reload' optional cover is referenced in the sequence of utilisation clause.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered; number of days as specified in Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table (not stated in wording text).

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered; number of days as specified in Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table (not stated in wording text).

day_care.note: Extensive list of 586+ procedures in Annexure II covered. List is indicative and subject to update.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered subject to minimum 3 consecutive days and medical necessity. Several conditions excluded (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy etc.).

ayush.note: AYUSH in-patient hospitalisation covered up to limits in Policy Schedule. AYUSH OPD also covered under OPD benefit. Treatment must be within India.

organ_donor.note: Medical expenses for organ harvesting from donor covered up to limits in Policy Schedule. Screening, pre/post-hospitalisation of donor, organ transport not covered.

ambulance.display: Covered up to Policy Schedule limit
ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered to nearest hospital for emergency and inter-hospital transfers if medically necessary. Specific rupee limit per Policy Schedule/Benefit Table. Air ambulance covered under Domestic/International Emergency Assistance (inbuilt additional benefit).

modern_treatments.note: Policy wording excludes certain specific treatments (RF ablation unless pre-approved, RFQMR, ECP, EECP, Hyperbaric Oxygen, KTP Laser, Cyber Knife, Femto laser, SMILE surgery, bioabsorbable implants, chelation therapy). No explicit modern treatments coverage clause found.

consumables.note: Non-medical/consumable expenses listed in Annexure I are excluded. Consumables waived only for Home Treatment (C.I.k) and Nursing at Home (C.IV.w) optional benefit to the extent specified.

global_cover.note: International Emergency Assistance (air ambulance/evacuation) is an inbuilt benefit for travel outside India up to 90 days. Treatment costs outside India are excluded (Section D.II.50). No optional global treatment cover mentioned.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration credits), no claim can be contested except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 30 days for quarterly, half-yearly and annual premium modes; 15 days for monthly premium mode.

free_look.note: Free-look period of 30 days from receipt of policy document for new individual policies. Not applicable on renewals or porting/migration.

portability.note: Portability to other insurers permitted as per IRDAI guidelines with continuity of waiting period credits.

notable_exclusions.display: Parkinson's disease, STDs (non-HIV), external congenital anomalies, stem cell therapy, treatment outside India, dental (non-accident), hearing aids/spectacles, sleep apnea devices

optional_riders.display: Room Upgrade, PPN Discount (15% co-pay at non-PPN), Nursing at Home, Lifestyle Support Equipment, Portable Medical Equipment, Advance Health Check-up
